method: Same-agent English/Marathi close reading, macro/import comparison and reverse paraphrase with checked native terminology; not independent or human review.
scope: The Propositional Logic part title, editorial scope note, FOL feature exclusion, valuation substitution and planned truth-functional completeness expansion.

samples.reverse_paraphrase: The part treats classical propositional logic. Its first chapter is elementary and leaves many proofs as exercises. Proof systems and completeness material are reused from first-order logic with the FOL tag false, omitting predicates, terms and quantifiers and replacing structures with truth-valuations.
samples.checks: The target preserves the distinction between propositional and first-order logic, the incompleteness of supplied proofs, the exact false-tag mechanism, all excluded feature classes, both glossary macros and both mathematical objects.

samples.reverse_paraphrase: The editors plan to expand the part with more detail and further topics and results, including truth-functional completeness.
samples.checks: The future-plan modality remains explicit and truth-functional completeness is not weakened to generic completeness.

limitations: No independent linguistic review has been performed.
सत्य-मूल्यांकन and अभिजात are provisional and explicitly prioritized for specialist review.
